zh.title: Trans Air Cargo DC-8貨機於金夏沙衝出跑道前起落架折斷
zh.summary: Trans Air Cargo貨機於金夏沙衝出跑道；前起落架折斷；官方啟動事故調查
body: 一架由Trans Air Cargo Service營運、國籍標誌暨登記號碼為9S-AJO的道格拉斯（Douglas）DC-8-73CF貨機，於2026年9月8日在剛果民主共和國金夏沙恩吉利國際機場（FIH）降落時偏離24號跑道左側，最終停在跑道旁邊的軟地上，前起落架折斷倒塌。這起事故造成該架四引擎噴射貨機呈現機頭朝下狀態停於草地。
剛果民主共和國航空事故與事件常設調查局（BPEA）已將本起衝出跑道事件正式歸類為航空事故，並已派遣調查人員前往機場現場。該調查機構呼籲相關單位，在調查人員完成現場勘查與各項檢驗之前，必須完整保留涉事航空器及現場所有相關證據。
根據事故發生當時的金夏沙周邊地區氣象報告顯示，現場出現薄霧且能見度有所降低，不過調查人員目前尚未說明氣候條件是否與本次衝出跑道事故有所關聯。現場照片與影像顯示機身主體結構受損，詳細損壞程度與後續能否修復仍待評估。
本次涉事的DC-8-73CF貨機機齡約為56年，最早以DC-8-63型號製造，屬於加長型的「Super 60」改型系列，隨後經由改裝計畫升級為搭載性能更為安靜且節省燃油之CFM56渦輪風扇發動機的DC-8-73標準規格。根據航空機隊資料庫顯示，該機為Trans Air Cargo Service旗下唯一處於現役營運狀態的航空器。

道格拉斯當年初步開發DC-8型噴射客機，主要用於與波音（Boeing）707型客機進行競爭，並於1959年率先在達美航空（Delta Air Lines）與聯合航空（United Airlines）投入商業營運。道格拉斯與麥道公司在1972年停產前累計生產了556架DC-8。雖然該機型已退役多年，但少數改裝發動機的貨機仍持續服役，包括秘魯天空巴士噴射貨運（Skybus Jet Cargo）營運的OB-2231P，而美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）與撒瑪利亞救援會（Samaritan's Purse）則分別於2024年與2025年退役其DC-8飛機。

en.title: Trans Air Cargo Service DC-8 Freighter Veers Off Kinshasa Runway and Collapses Nose Gear
en.summary: Trans Air Cargo Service DC-8 veers off runway in Kinshasa; nose gear collapses; accident investigation opened.
body: A Douglas DC-8-73CF freighter registered 9S-AJO and operated by Trans Air Cargo Service suffered a nose gear collapse after veering off Runway 24 at N’Djili International Airport (FIH) in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on September 8, 2026. The four-engine jet ran left off the runway and came to a stop on soft ground in the adjacent grass resting nose-down.

The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bureau Permanent d’Enquêtes d’Accidents et Incidents d’Aviation (BPEA) officially classified the runway excursion as an accident and dispatched investigators to the scene. The investigative agency instructed that the aircraft and all related physical evidence be preserved at the airport until safety personnel can complete their examinations.

Meteorological reports from around the time of the event indicated reduced visibility and mist in the Kinshasa area. However, authorities have not confirmed whether weather conditions contributed to the excursion. Airport imagery showed structural impact around the front landing gear, and officials have not determined whether the 56-year-old aircraft can be repaired.

The aircraft involved was originally constructed as a DC-8-63 model under the "Super 60" series before undergoing a conversion to DC-8-73 standards, which installed CFM56 turbofan engines. According to fleet database records, the jet represented the only active aircraft in Trans Air Cargo Service's commercial fleet and was among the last remaining operational DC-8 freighters worldwide.

First entering commercial service in 1959 with Delta Air Lines and United Airlines, the DC-8 was developed by Douglas as a direct competitor to the Boeing 707. Production ended in 1972 after 556 units were built. Other late-stage operational DC-8s included an aircraft registered OB-2231P flown by Skybus Jet Cargo in Peru, while NASA retired its research laboratory unit in 2024 and Samaritan's Purse retired its last US-registered example in 2025.

zh.title: 斐濟航空將開航西雪梨國際機場 預計2027年3月起營運
zh.summary: 斐濟航空宣布2027年3月開航楠迪至西雪梨航線，每週營運三班。
body: 斐濟航空（Fiji Airways）正式宣布將開航往返楠迪國際機場（NAN）與西雪梨國際機場（WSI）的直飛航線，成為首家宣布連結斐濟與西雪梨新機場的國際航空公司。該項全新國際航線預計於2027年3月19日正式投入營運。
根據規劃，該航線將於每週一、週五及週日營運三個班次，並統一採用波音737 MAX 8客機執飛。斐濟航空指出，這項服務每年將為楠迪與西雪梨兩地之間增加超過5萬3000個客運座位，顯著提升雙邊的航空旅運容量。
在航班時間配置方面，去程航班FJ 991預計於當地時間19時10分自楠迪國際機場起飛，並於當晚22時55分飛抵西雪梨國際機場；回程航班FJ 990則於深夜23時55分自西雪梨起飛，並於次日清晨04時55分返抵楠迪。
斐濟航空表示，清晨抵達楠迪的航班時間安排，方便旅客於抵達後轉機前往斐濟境內其他目的地，或是轉接至東加、薩摩亞等該公司更廣泛航網覆蓋的太平洋島國航點。
這項全新服務將補充斐濟航空現有往返楠迪與雪梨金斯福德·史密斯國際機場（SYD）的每日兩班定期航班。新航線投入營運後，斐濟航空在大雪梨地區與斐濟之間的整體運力將增加至每日最多三班。
斐濟航空董事總經理兼行政總裁Paul Scurrah表示，西雪梨地區擁有斐濟以外最大的斐濟裔社群之一。該直飛航線除促進觀光旅遊外，更能方便在地社群與親友保持緊密聯繫，推動兩地民航市場持續發展。

en.title: Fiji Airways to Launch Direct Western Sydney Flights in March 2027
en.summary: Fiji Airways will launch direct flights between Nadi and Western Sydney International Airport in March 2027.
body: Fiji Airways has announced the launch of direct scheduled flights between Nadi International Airport (NAN) and Western Sydney International Airport (WSI), making it the first international airline to connect Fiji with Sydney's new airport. The new international service is scheduled to commence on March 19, 2027.

The route will operate three times weekly on Mondays, Fridays, and Sundays utilizing the airline's Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft. According to the carrier, this service will add more than 53,000 annual seats between the two destinations, providing significant additional passenger capacity.

Under the announced schedule, Flight FJ 991 will depart Nadi International Airport at 19:10 local time and arrive at Western Sydney International Airport at 22:55 local time. The return flight, FJ 990, will depart WSI at 23:55 local time and land back in Nadi at 04:55 local time the following morning.

The airline noted that the early morning arrival time in Nadi is designed to facilitate convenient onward connections within Fiji, as well as to international destinations across its broader network including Tonga and Samoa.

The new service to Western Sydney will complement Fiji Airways' existing twice-daily services between Nadi and Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (SYD). Once active, the route will expand the airline's total operational capacity between Fiji and the Greater Sydney region to up to three flights daily.

Fiji Airways Managing Director and CEO Paul Scurrah highlighted that Western Sydney is home to one of the largest Fijian communities outside Fiji. He noted that the new route will strengthen travel connections for family and friends while supporting continued growth in regional tourism.

zh.title: 埃及航空將開航雪梨航線 星空聯盟睽違逾20年重返澳洲
zh.summary: 埃及航空將開航20小時雪梨新航線；星空聯盟預計睽違逾20年重返澳洲。
body: 根據航空新聞網站 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 9 日的報導指出，埃及航空（EgyptAir）正準備開航一條飛往澳洲雪梨的全新航線，這條航線的飛行時間預計將長達 20 小時。此一長途航線的開闢，對該航空公司而言是一項令人驚喜的最新發展。
此外，該報導亦提及星空聯盟（Star Alliance）預計將在睽違 20 多年後，重新返回澳洲市場。不過，目前關於該雪梨新航線的具體啟航日期、航班時刻表以及執飛機型等進一步細節，在報導中尚未獲得具體披露。

en.title: EgyptAir to Launch 20-Hour Sydney Route as Star Alliance Prepares for Australia Return
en.summary: EgyptAir is launching a 20-hour Sydney route; Star Alliance is set to return to Australia.
body: According to a report published by the aviation news website Simple Flying on September 9, 2026, EgyptAir is launching a surprising new route to Sydney with a flight duration of 20 hours. This new long-haul route marks a major development for the carrier.

The publication also highlights that Star Alliance is set to return to Australia after more than 20 years. At the time of reporting, further details concerning the operational schedule, specific launch dates, and the aircraft type to be used on this 20-hour flight to Sydney have not been disclosed.

zh.title: 法國海軍接收首兩架Falcon信天翁海上監視機
zh.summary: 法國海軍接收首兩架Falcon信天翁監視機，並已由接收單位展開測試。
body: 法國國防採購局（DGA）已正式接受開發階段，並接收了首兩架 Falcon 2000LXS Albatros（信天翁）海上監視機。在2026年9月8日發表的一份聲明中，法國國防採購局表示，該機構已於2026年7月27日和7月31日交付了首批兩架監視機，目前這兩架飛機已抵達位於布列塔尼的蘭比胡埃（Lann-Bihoué）海軍航空基地。
這批監視機已分配至法國海軍第 24F 中隊（Flottille 24F）。法國海軍的試飛與接收單位「海軍航空實踐實驗與接收中心」（CEPA）已經開始對該機型進行軍事測試，以為宣告初始作戰能力做好準備。
該引進計畫屬於「海上監視與干預飛機」（AVSIMAR）計畫，預計共引進十二架飛機。其中七架飛機於2020年12月訂購，另外五架則於2025年9月26日追加訂購。法國國防採購局指出，第三架飛機計劃於2026年底前交付，後續將以每年兩架的速度交付，並於2031年完成全數十二架飛機的部署。

這十二架 Albatros 監視機將用以取代現有的十三架舊型飛機，包括部署於莫爾比昂省的八架 Falcon 50M，以及部署於太平洋地區的五架 Falcon 200 Gardian 飛機。該舊型機隊的退役作業已於2025年展開。Albatros 監視機是由 Falcon 2000LXS 改裝而成，配備泰雷茲（Thales）SearchMaster X 頻段主動電子掃描陣列雷達、賽峰（Safran）EuroFLIR 410 光電轉塔以及海軍集團（Naval Group）開發的任務系統。
除了 AVSIMAR 計畫外，法國也正透過 PATMAR 計畫汰換其 Atlantique 2 海上巡邏機機隊。在該汰換計畫中，法國國防採購局（DGA）已選擇了由空中巴士（Airbus）開發的空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）MPA 方案

en.title: French Navy Receives First Two Falcon 2000LXS Albatros Maritime Surveillance Aircraft
en.summary: French Navy receives first two Falcon Albatros surveillance aircraft in Brittany for military trials.
body: The French defense procurement agency, Direction générale de l’armement (DGA), has formally accepted the development phase and the first two Falcon 2000LXS Albatros maritime surveillance aircraft. In an official statement published on September 8, 2026, the DGA announced that it delivered these first two aircraft on July 27 and July 31, 2026, which have already arrived at the Lann-Bihoué naval air base in Brittany.

These initial maritime surveillance aircraft have been assigned to Flottille 24F. The Centre d’Expérimentations Pratiques et de Réception de l’Aéronautique Navale (CEPA), which serves as the French Navy’s trials and acceptance unit, has officially commenced military testing of the Albatros aircraft ahead of an initial operational capability declaration.

This procurement is part of the Avion de Surveillance et d’Intervention Maritime (AVSIMAR) program, which covers a total of twelve aircraft. The DGA originally ordered seven aircraft in December 2020 and placed a follow-on order for five additional units on September 26, 2025. According to the DGA schedule, a third aircraft is slated for delivery by the end of 2026, with subsequent deliveries proceeding at a cadence of two per year to complete the fleet of twelve by 2031.

The twelve Albatros aircraft will replace a legacy fleet of thirteen aircraft, which comprises eight Falcon 50M aircraft based in Morbihan and five Falcon 200 Gardian aircraft stationed in the Pacific region. The gradual withdrawal of these older maritime surveillance aircraft commenced in 2025. The Albatros is a converted Falcon 2000LXS business jet, featuring a Thales SearchMaster X-band active electronically scanned array radar, a Safran EuroFLIR 410 optronic turret, and a mission system developed by Naval Group.

Separately from the AVSIMAR surveillance program, France is also replacing its Atlantique 2 maritime patrol aircraft fleet under the PATMAR program. For this requirement, the DGA has selected the Airbus A321 MPA, based on the Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321) platform.

zh.title: 美國陸軍工兵部隊簽訂7478萬美元合約興建B-21隱身測量棚廠
zh.summary: 美軍簽訂7478萬美元合約；於懷特曼興建B-21測量棚廠；2029完工
body: 美國陸軍工兵部隊堪薩斯城分區於2026年9月8日正式在五角大廈每日合約清單中公布，已向 Conti Federal Services 頒發一項價值7,478萬7,155美元的固定總價合約。該合約旨在位於密蘇里州的懷特曼空軍基地興建一座專用的 B-21 雷達波與無線電頻率測量棚廠，主要用於檢驗 B-21 隱形轟炸機（B-21 Raider）是否持續具備低可偵測性特徵，整體施工預計於2029年9月25日完成。
根據美國空軍2026財年軍事建設預算文件說明，這座規劃面積達5,345平方公尺（約57,533平方英呎）的設施包含安全與非安全區域，配備測量灣、維修區、飛機電源供應室、伺服器與資料分析室、辦公室及複合材料工具箱儲存區。為了確保測量精確度並防止干擾，棚廠牆壁與天花板均設計有屏蔽層，測量區域鋪設靜電防護地板，棚廠門封條則融入無線電頻率屏蔽銅網，燈具等穿透孔洞亦經特殊處理。
美軍文件亦指出，該測量灣的空間規格經專門設計，能夠完整容納現役的 B-2 隱形轟炸機（B-2 Spirit，作為 B-21 的替代測量對象），同時維持與牆面、結構元件及設備之間的必要安全距離。若缺乏此項設施，懷特曼基地將無法在本地為 B-21 進行關鍵的維護檢驗，被迫將相關維修程序移至其他地點執行。

懷特曼基地於2024年9月獲選為第二座 B-21 主要營運基地，僅次於南達科他州的埃爾斯沃思空軍基地，並領先德克薩斯州的戴斯空軍基地。目前懷特曼基地駐有第509與第131轟炸機聯隊營運的 B-2 轟炸機隊。在此之前，埃爾斯沃思基地已於2023年4月獲得由奧馬哈分區頒發的7,049萬3,604美元合約興建同類棚廠。美軍於2026財年在三個主要營運基地同步推進基礎設施建設，並於2026年2月達成一項45億美元的協議，計畫將 B-21 年產能提升約25%。

en.title: US Army Corps Awards $74.78M Contract for B-21 Hangar at Whiteman AFB
en.summary: US Army Corps of Engineers awarded $74.78M contract for B-21 stealth hangar at Whiteman Air Force Base.
body: The US Army Corps of Engineers Kansas City District has awarded Conti Federal Services a $74,787,155 firm-fixed-price contract to build a specialized radio frequency and measurements hangar at Whiteman Air Force Base, Missouri. According to the Pentagon daily contracts list published on September 8, 2026, the new facility will be dedicated to inspecting B-21 Raider bombers to verify that they maintain their low-observable stealth characteristics. Work on the hangar is scheduled for completion by September 25, 2029.

Air Force fiscal year 2026 military construction documents reveal that the planned 5,345-square-meter (57,533-square-foot) facility will encompass both secure and non-secure areas. It will feature a primary measurement bay, maintenance area, aircraft power supply room, server and data analysis rooms, administrative offices, and composite tool-kit storage. To prevent internal radio frequency interference, the hangar design incorporates shielding on the walls and ceiling, electrostatic-dissipative flooring across the measurement bay, and RF-shielding copper mesh integrated into hangar door seals.

According to USAF budget documentation, the hangar measurement bay is specifically dimensioned to fully enclose a B-2 Spirit bomber—serving as the B-21 surrogate—while preserving necessary clearance from structural elements, equipment, and walls. Air Force officials noted that without this facility, Whiteman Air Force Base would be unable to conduct critical low-observable maintenance inspections locally, forcing aircraft to be moved elsewhere for essential maintenance procedures.

Whiteman Air Force Base was designated as the second B-21 main operating base in September 2024, following Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and ahead of Dyess Air Force Base in Texas. Whiteman currently operates the B-2 Spirit fleet assigned to the 509th and 131st Bomb Wings. Conti Federal previously received a $70,493,604 contract from the Corps of Engineers Omaha District in April 2023 for a similar radio frequency hangar at Ellsworth. The ongoing infrastructure expansion coincides with a $4.5 billion agreement signed in February 2026 to boost annual B-21 production capacity by approximately 25 percent.

zh.title: 川普威脅除非移往美國生產否則禁止龐巴迪銷售飛機
zh.summary: 川普威脅除非移至美國生產否則禁售龐巴迪飛機；業者隨後發聲明捍衛美國供應鏈
body: 美國總統川普於2026年9月7日在社群媒體上威脅，除非加拿大飛機製造商龐巴迪將生產線移往美國，否則將禁止該公司在美國銷售飛機。川普聲稱龐巴迪的產品「不夠好」，並表示若想進入美國市場就必須在當地製造。不過，目前並無任何隨之發布的行政命令、關稅表或監管行動。
龐巴迪於同日發表聲明回應，強調其現有的美國製造業務與供應鏈網路。該公司指出，旗下Global 8000型客機的機翼是在德州紅橡市製造，飛行控制部件則在洛杉磯地區生產。龐巴迪補充，該公司在美國47個州與約2800家供應商合作，每年在美採購金額超過25億美元。

en.title: Trump Threatens to Ban Bombardier Jet Sales in the US Unless Production Moves Locally
en.summary: Donald Trump threatens to block Bombardier US aircraft sales; the manufacturer defends its American industrial footprint.
body: US President Donald Trump has threatened to ban Montreal-based manufacturer Bombardier from selling its aircraft in the United States unless production moves there. On September 7, 2026, Trump wrote on social media that the company's products "aren't good enough" and must be built locally to access the US market. No executive order or regulatory action accompanied the post.

In response, Bombardier highlighted its existing US operations in a statement on September 7, 2026. The manufacturer noted that wings for its Global 8000 are built in Red Oak, Texas, and flight controls are produced in the Los Angeles area. Bombardier added that it works with 2,800 US suppliers across 47 states, spending over $2.5 billion annually.

zh.title: Breeze Airways退役最後一架E190客機 轉型全A220機隊
zh.summary: Breeze Airways退役最後一架E190，完成全A220機隊轉型。
body: Breeze Airways 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日執飛了最後一班巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）客機航班，正式完成機隊過渡，轉型為全空中巴士 A220-300 機隊。該航空公司最初於 2021 年 5 月投入商業營運，當時擁有 10 架 E190 與 3 架較大的巴西航空工業E195（ICAO機型代碼E195）客機。
截至目前，Breeze Airways 已從其 90 架空中巴士 A220-300 的確認訂單中接收了 55 架飛機，並另外保有 30 架的選擇權。該航空公司創辦人兼執行長 David Neeleman 表示，其長期策略始終是利用 A220-300 的優勢與效率，以具備成本效益的方式擴展其航網。

en.title: Breeze Airways Retires Last Embraer E190 to Transition to All-Airbus A220 Fleet
en.summary: Breeze Airways retired its final Embraer E190 on September 7, transitioning to an all-A220-300 fleet.
body: Breeze Airways operated its final Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) flight on September 7, 2026, completing its fleet transition to an all-Airbus A220-300 fleet. The US carrier originally launched commercial service in May 2021 utilizing ten E190s and three larger Embraer E195 (ICAO type code E195) aircraft.

Breeze Airways has taken delivery of 55 aircraft from its firm order of 90 Airbus A220-300s, while holding options for an additional 30. Founder and CEO David Neeleman stated that the airline's long-term strategy focuses on leveraging the efficiencies of the A220-300 to cost-effectively scale its business model.
